LESSON: READING 11.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: NON- FICTION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to read widely? 2. How do you choose reading material?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Extensive Reading: Non- fiction together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self -efficacy: The learner selects reading materials to enhance their ability to make decisions.

● Learning to learn: The learner scans through print with appropriate font size and colour contrast/braille and electronic reading

materials on careers and shares with peers.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner engages in the selection of reading material individually.

All subjects require extensive reading as the learner interacts with reference materials.
